proofs.text: Open the board with the regulated fixture at widths 1440 and 1024 with every group open; verify that for each spec row, each cell's left edge is within 1 pixel of its heading's left edge

rule_text: Every column heading of the spec table starts where its column's cells start in every row, so a wide cell never pushes its row's columns out of line with the headings

tests.body:
def test_every_heading_starts_where_its_cells_start(browser, tmp_path):  # noqa: F811
    for width in (1440, 1024):
        page = open_board(browser, tmp_path / str(width),
                          payload_named('regulated'),
                          viewport={'width': width, 'height': 1000})
        offsets = page.evaluate(OFFSETS)
        assert offsets, 'no spec row rendered'
        worst = max(max(row) for row in offsets)
        assert worst <= 1, (width, offsets)
        page.close()
